instruction: Create an ORIGINAL PURE-DART reusable package named aivexus_adjacent_pairs, Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0. Implement exactly this PUBLIC TOP-LEVEL Dart function in lib/adjacent_pairs.dart: List<List<int>> adjacentPairs(List<int> input). Build a new list of consecutive overlapping integer pairs: for each adjacent indices i,i+1 output a new two-element list. For length 0 or 1 return empty list. Preserve negatives, duplicates and input. Fully implement working behavior yourself, not a stub. Write reasonable tests under test/. You may use Dart core List, Map, Set, loops and standard library methods only. No third-party runtime dependencies, networking, filesystem, FFI, shell or privileged APIs. Always use valid Dart SDK APIs and compileable types. Return the strict JSON source object requested by the system prompt.
